list: the official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide, tip, kind, missable flag and roadmap stage is this guide's own work, written from those descriptions.

sources.name: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
sources.role: Every trophy's name, description and grade, and the counts the descriptions state.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 PS5 trophy list report, 18 November 2026
sources.role: Confirms the public list: 55 trophies including a Platinum, no online trophies.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no shortcut: it needs the gold A Long Road, which is 100% completion, so the platinum is the last trophy you earn. Follow the roadmap in order and use this tracker to see what is left; the platinum pops the moment 100% lands.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Do not chase the platinum directly — chase the 54, and it comes free.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and unlocks automatically as the story opens — you cannot miss it. If the trophy has not popped, keep playing the opening sequence; it lands when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Your first trophy. Just play.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Story progress only — play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes. Nothing here is missable; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Chapter trophies are automatic. Enjoy the story.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Like every chapter trophy, it cannot be missed — the story always passes through Chapter 2.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: If a mission gives you trouble, lower the difficulty and keep going; the chapter still counts.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes. The trophy pops when Chapter 3 ends — no side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Chapter 3 opens up more of Leonida. Take the detours later; the chapter itself is linear.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes; the trophy pops at the end of Chapter 4. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the story's end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Stock up before the final stretch — the last missions are the hardest fights in the story.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the story's last mission, after Chapter 4 — finish it and the gold pops. It is the last story trophy; after it, the endgame and the 100% cleanup begin, and the whole map is yours.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Finish the story before grinding anything else — the endgame opens the whole state.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. This one is tied to a single story mission, so play it when the story offers it — that is the missable part. If you finish the story without it, replay Breakfast Run from the pause menu's mission replay and complete it again; the trophy pops on the replay.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Missable only in the sense that it belongs to one mission. Mission replay recovers it.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is tied to that one story mission, so take it when the story offers it. If the story moves on without the pop, replay The Cartel Heist from the pause menu's mission replay and finish it again.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Heist missions are long — set aside real time before you start one.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. The trophy belongs to that one story mission, so play it when it comes up in the story. Missed it? Replay Child's Play from the pause menu and complete it — the trophy pops on the replay.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Mission replay is the safety net for every story-mission trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is tied to that one story mission, so take it when the story offers it. If the pop does not come, replay Headliners from the pause menu's mission replay and finish it again.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Do the story missions in order — the missable flags are all in this stage.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The trophy belongs to that one story mission at Vice City International Airport, so play it when the story offers it. If you miss the pop, replay VCIA Takedown from the pause menu and complete it again.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Learn the airport layout here — you will come back for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is tied to that one story mission, so take it when the story offers it. If the trophy does not pop, replay Operation Savage Glory from the pause menu's mission replay and finish it again.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: The last of the missable story missions. After this, the story trophies are all automatic.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one: the completion checklist covers story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries. The checklist opens after the story; work the roadmap stages in order and use this tracker's filters to see what is left. It pops the moment the checklist hits 100% — and the platinum follows at once.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: 100% is a checklist, not a grind. The filters in this guide show exactly what is left.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. A stunt is any jump, near-miss, wheelie, stoppie or airtime the game scores — chain them while driving between objectives instead of making special trips. The count is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up naturally; if you are short at the end, use the jumps and ramps around Vice City to grind the rest.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Drive like a show-off on every trip and the 250 takes care of itself.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — 9 types in all. The activity types are the game's side activities: races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and challenges. Sample one of each; the trophy pops on the ninth type, not on mastery of any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: One taste of everything. Do it early and it is free.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and time; gold needs a high score, not just a pass. Learn each range's layout, use the right weapon for the distance, and replay a challenge as many times as it takes — there is no limit. Do these in the activities stage, after the story, when you can travel freely.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Gold is about score, not speed alone. Slow down and aim.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in all. Each location hosts its own race; win each one once. Learn the gates on a practice run, then race clean: cutting corners loses more time than it saves. Check off each win in the tracker as you go.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Fly the course once slowly to learn the gates, then race it for real.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once — winning the same race twice adds nothing. Work through the race list across Leonida; road, off-road and water races all count toward the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Variety counts, repetition does not. Tick off 20 different races.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge, then out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not let the fish run the line out. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy is for the win, not the first try.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Patience beats speed in fishing. Steady reeling wins.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and play it through to its end — a high score is not needed, completion is. The easiest cabinet is the shortest one; finish it once and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Pick the shortest cabinet. Completion, not score, is what counts.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work Andy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission completes. Contact finales unlock as the story progresses, so this is a stage-2 trophy — finish the story first, then clear the contact strands one by one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Contact strands are the story's second act. Clear them after the finale.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work Kenton's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission completes. Like the other contact finales, it opens up as the story progresses and is finished in the contacts stage.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: One strand at a time. Kenton's is the water-side one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work Billy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission completes. Contact finales are straightforward once the story is done — follow the strand markers.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Billy's strand is the rider's one. Follow the markers.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as marked encounters around the state; each strand is a short chain of missions. Complete any 8 strands — there are more than 8 available, so skip any strand you dislike. The tracker lists the strands you have finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: More than 8 strands exist. Skip the ones you hate.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work Randy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission completes. Contact finales open as the story progresses and are cleared in the contacts stage.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Randy's strand is the supply-line one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work Tyrone's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission completes. Finish the story first, then clear the contact strands in any order.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Tyrone's is the last contact strand for most players.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 in all. Meditation spots are marked quiet places around the state; sit and meditate at each one. They are a collectible in all but name, so sweep them in the exploration stage with the map open and tick each spot off.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Quiet places, not hidden ones. Sweep them with the map open.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt sends you after one specific animal; track it in its habitat, approach downwind, and take a clean shot. A missed shot scares it off — save before the hunt so a bad shot costs you nothing.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Save before the hunt. One clean shot is the whole job.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Finish any 3 sets — you do not need every card in the game. Sweep one district at a time and mark each card you find.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Three sets, not all of them. Pick the sets nearest to finished.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It spots are scattered across Leonida; use one at each of 100 different spots. The count is per location, so revisiting the same spot adds nothing — keep moving to new ones.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: New spots only. A route that hits fresh locations is the grind.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's open-world tasks — stunts, driving, combat and exploration feats. They stack up as you play; check the challenge list in the pause menu and clear the easy ones first. 50 is well under the total available, so there is no need to chase the hard ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Clear the easy challenges first. 50 is well under the total.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Missable in setup, not in story: you need your partner beside you when the wanted level hits 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. Do it with a fast car and a planned escape route; if your partner is downed or you are busted, set it up again.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Partner beside you, 4 stars, then vanish. Plan the escape first.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Missable in setup: the three robberies must be consecutive and your wanted level must survive all three — so plan the route, hit three shops close together, and keep the heat low between them. If the wanted level drops, start the chain again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Three shops, one chain, wanted level alive throughout. Route it first.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts the first time you get in or drive it — 100 distinct models across Leonida. Steal, borrow and buy across the map; the tracker counts models, so a second copy of a car you own adds nothing.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: New models only. A second copy of a car you own adds nothing.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least 5 enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop 5 before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the place — do not waste it on two or three enemies. If you fall short, the next big fight is another chance.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Save Combat Focus for a crowded fight. Five in one use is the bar.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Missable in setup: at Vice City International Airport, take an aircraft and leave without a flight plan — the game flags the unscheduled departure. Use a small plane on a quiet runway and get airborne before security responds.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Small plane, quiet runway, no flight plan. Get airborne fast.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhino tanks — the description is a joke, the task is surviving them. Use heavy weapons or hijack one yourself; the trophy pops when the Rhino encounter is resolved. Stock up on explosives first and do not fight them in the open.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Explosives first, open ground never. Or hijack one yourself.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Missable in the attempt, not the story: pick a store, go in quiet, and take the goods without tripping the alarm or being seen. If you are spotted, leave and try another store — the trophy is for one clean job.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: One clean job. If you are spotted, walk away and try another store.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault jobs, each ending in a clean escape. Plan the getaway before the job, not after — the escape is the part that fails most runs. The count is cumulative, so each successful vault adds one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Plan the getaway before the job. The escape fails more runs than the vault.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, stop it, take the cash and get away clean. A blocked road and a fast getaway car turn a hard job into a routine one.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Block the road, take the cash, leave fast. A classic for a reason.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map; an area counts when you enter it. Sweep district by district with the map open and this tracker will show which areas are still unvisited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: District by district, map open. 52 areas, none of them hidden.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang. The operations are marked once you find them; work the list gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: One operation per gang. Work the list gang by gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beach bar, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment, not a challenge — the trophy pops when the drink is served with the ocean in front of you.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: A quiet moment. Beach bar, cocktail, ocean view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Missable in setup: drive a car through the showroom glass and out the front — the game wants the dramatic exit, not a quiet one. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up and floor it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Clear run-up, foot down, through the glass. The dramatic exit is the point.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley, play a game, and follow through on your throws — the trophy is for playing the game through, not for a particular score. One full game is enough.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: One full game. Score does not matter, finishing does.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description is deliberately vague — this one is about your partnership drawing a crowd. Play partner activities and build the partnership's following; the trophy pops when the partnership's appeal peaks. Watch the in-game social feed for the prompt when it appears.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: The description is vague on purpose. Play partner activities and watch the social feed.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500: the choices you make across the game — dialogue picks, mission approaches, side decisions — add up. There is no single moment to catch; keep playing and choosing, and the trophy pops at 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: No single moment. Keep choosing and the count reaches 500 on its own.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is for the comeback, not the failure. A failed mission attempt followed by a clean retry is the natural way it pops; do not force it, it will come.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Do not force it. A failed attempt followed by a clean retry pops it naturally.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd encounters — a strange light, an odd figure, a scene that does not fit. Explore the quiet corners of the map and the trophy pops when you find one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Explore the quiet corners. The strange things are off the main roads.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, lean out and knock someone down with a melee weapon — a drive-by without a gun. Slow down beside a pedestrian, swing, and keep moving. It pops on the first clean hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Slow down, lean out, swing. First clean hit pops it.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists; launder them through your contacts to clean the money. The count is cumulative — keep laundering after every big job and the total climbs to $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Launder after every big job. The total climbs on its own.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up as you play; if you are short at the end, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: It builds up as you play. Save the big purchases for the end if you are short.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all. Garages are bought around Leonida; each one is a property purchase. Buy all 8 and the trophy pops. They are also useful: each garage is storage for the vehicles the tracker counts.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Eight garages, and each one stores the cars you are collecting anyway.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles and register each one in the app — the count is per vehicle, so ten different registrations. Scooter Bros takes most road vehicles; register as you discover them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.tip: Register as you discover. Ten different vehicles, ten registrations.
